speech:
Well, butter my biscuit and call me a breakfast buffet, Grizzly Rips, y'all did it! That's an A+, folks, and you earned every bit of it.

We woke up this morning in Division 3 with 0 of 12 points. We go to bed in Division 2. It was not a straight road. We lost 1-2 to Abdina fc, ran out of chances, and stared a relegation match right in the face. And what did y'all do? Beat Nonie United 2-0, hit 12 points with a 6-1 thumping of Cotteville Bums, then won 3 of 4 promotion matches, sealing it 4-2 against IronClad City. That's not a comeback, friends, that's a resurrection with a marching band.

8 wins from 13, 40 goals scored, and a team rating of 8.24 against our usual 7.82. And y'all got stronger as the night went on, with 15 points in the back half versus 9 up front.

Now, honest Coach time. We conceded 27. That 3-7 against Cineplex fc was ugly, plain and simple, and closing 2-5 to TheMostWanted left a sour taste. Our shot selection was wild, too. PhogsToffees, 49 shots and only 23 on target. Work it into the middle of the box, set your feet, and if the angle's tight, cut it back. A better shot beats a first shot.

BellyTb1, you were a runaway freight train loaded with fireworks. 15 goals, 8 assists, 5 Man of the Match awards, and a perfect 10.0 to open the night, your 5th Perfect Game. But against 6 Half Pints you had 2 on-ball actions when you usually have 33. Your tackling dipped to 31% from your usual 49%, and in that last match their best forward posted a 9.8 to your 6.6. Stay switched on, even when you're cooking.

PhogsToffees, you see passes the rest of us need a map for. 27 key passes, 10 assists, 12 goals. And a 9.9 in that Cineplex mess, winning 67% of your tackles while the house was on fire. That's character. Match 4, though, was a 5.8 with 1 on-ball action. You vanished like my sense of direction in a corn maze.

buddskees, you came in at match 5 and brought a toolbox. A perfect 10.0 in the 6-1, your 6th Perfect Game, and tackling at 53% against your usual 31%. That's grit. But against Byron City you didn't take a single shot, and against TheMostWanted you misplaced 8 passes. Little things, sure, but you're too good for little things.

Two A days back to back, y'all. Division 2 has 16 points waiting for us, and I believe in this group the way I believe in pie for breakfast. Get some rest, dream big, and tomorrow we go climbing again. Proud of you. So darn proud.
